title: Ravin bar Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bava Batra 43a he speaks in Shmuel’s name. In Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 5:5: Rabbi Avin in the name of Shmuel. The Rosh’s reading in his commentary there, and the work cited as ברד״בז, Kilayim 6:2, is Rabbi Avin bar Shmuel.

notes.text: The supplied bibliographic form is ברד״בז, followed by Kilayim 6:2. Its exact expansion and work have not been established here; it is not automatically assigned to the Radbaz on Mishneh Torah. The reviewer’s proposed identification is not evidence of that attribution. Bava Batra 43a in the William Davidson digital text confirms Ravin bar Shmuel reporting Shmuel.

Hyman’s printing (vol. I, p. 96) has the abbreviated citation ברד״בז and locates the Yerushalmi passage at Kilayim 5:5. The Guggenheimer edition numbers the passage 5:4 and has Rabbi Avin speaking in Shmuel’s name. In Ahavat Tsiyon vi-Yerushalayim (vol. V, pp. 39–40), Ratner reports a reading naming Rabbi Avin as Shmuel’s son in both the Rosh’s commentary on the Yerushalmi and the Radbaz’s commentary on the Laws of Kilayim 6:2. The cited editions are known here through Ratner’s report.
